name: Aokie Phone
description: Place and answer calls, speak on a live call, and send or read SMS through the paired phone. Backed by the Aokie plugin's own connector commands, so a flow gets the same surface the receptionist uses.

actions.title: Place a call
actions.description: Dial a number and speak an opening line verbatim when they answer. Subject to the plugin's own outbound consent, kill switch, quiet hours and daily dial cap — none of which this action can bypass.

number.description: The number to dial, in the account's dialling format.

openingLine.description: The exact first words spoken when they answer. Spoken verbatim, so write it as speech.

purpose.description: What the call is for. Grounds the agent's conversation; never spoken as-is.

actions.title: Speak on the live call
actions.description: Say something on the call that is currently connected.

callId.description: Which call. Defaults to the active one.

actions.title: End the call
actions.description: Hang up the active call, or a specific one.

callId.description: Which call. Defaults to the active one.

actions.title: Read the current call
actions.description: Who is on the line right now, and for how long. Returns an empty state when nothing is connected.

actions.title: Send an SMS
actions.description: Send a text message from the paired phone.

messageId.description: Your own id for this message. Supplying one makes a retry idempotent instead of sending twice.

actions.title: List SMS conversations
actions.description: Every conversation on the paired phone, most recent first.

actions.title: Read one SMS conversation
actions.description: The messages in a single conversation.

actions.title: Read the phone connection
actions.description: Whether the dongle and phone are connected, and what the radio is doing.
